title: Spectrum TG480RTTR Rear Tine Rotary Cultivator
description_html:
Spectrum TG480RTTR Rear Tine Rotary Cultivator

Rear-tine tillers don’t come much more powerful or productive than the Spectrum TG480RTTR – a well-built, heavy-duty machine designed to take on demanding digging jobs across gardens and allotments with ease.

At its core is a robust 211cc air-cooled 4-stroke OHV engine, engineered for durability and consistent performance. The overhead valve design not only enhances efficiency but also reduces fuel consumption, noise, and emissions—delivering reliable power without compromise.

A belt-driven transmission ensures smooth power delivery and optimal torque transfer to the heavy-duty tines, allowing the machine to break through compacted soil with ease. Combined with a large-capacity fuel tank, the TG480RTTR is built for extended working sessions with fewer interruptions.

For improved control, the tiller features a two-speed gearbox (1 forward + 1 reverse), making it easier to manoeuvre, reposition, and work in tighter areas. Whether you’re turning over soil or navigating confined spaces, you’ll benefit from greater flexibility and ease of use.

With a generous 48cm working width, this cultivator covers more ground in less time—ideal for larger plots. A sturdy debris guard is also included, helping to protect the operator from flying soil and stones for safer operation.

Delivery & Assembly:

The Spectrum TG480RTTR is supplied boxed for home assembly. For a more convenient option, choose our Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) service—we’ll fully assemble, test, and prepare your machine before delivery. Where possible, we’ll deliver by van and provide a brief demonstration, so you can get started straight away with confidence.

title: Spectrum TG45SC Petrol Lawn Scarifier/Aerator
description_html:
If your lawn is struggling with moss, thatch, or weeds, the Spectrum TG45SC is the ideal solution. Designed to rejuvenate tired grass areas, this versatile 2-in-1 machine allows you to both scarify and aerate with ease, helping you achieve a healthier, more vibrant lawn all year round.

Perfect for use after periods of drought and during key lawn care seasons such as spring and autumn, this machine is suitable for maintaining lawns up to 2000m².

Powerful & Reliable Performance

At the heart of the TG45SC  is a robust 223cc easy-start petrol engine, delivering consistent power to tackle compacted soil and stubborn thatch. The reliable recoil start system ensures quick ignition, so you can get to work without delay. The machine runs on standard unleaded petrol for convenience.

2-in-1 Scarifying & Aerating

With a wide 45cm working width and 18 durable blades, this machine makes light work of lawn renovation. The 6 adjustable working heights (-12mm to +10mm) allow you to tailor the depth precisely to your lawn’s needs, improving air, water, and nutrient penetration for stronger, healthier growth.

Blade Engage System

A practical blade engagement feature adds both convenience and safety. Simply activate the green lever to engage the blades when working, and release it to stop them instantly—ideal when emptying the collector. The engine continues running, saving time and effort by eliminating the need for frequent restarts.

Durable & User-Friendly Design

Built with a strong steel deck, the TG45SC  is designed for long-term durability. Foldable handles with soft grips provide comfort during extended use and make storage more convenient. Double ball-bearing wheels ensure smooth manoeuvrability across a range of surfaces.

Efficient Debris Collection

The large 45-litre collector captures moss, thatch, and debris efficiently, reducing clean-up time and interruptions. For heavier debris, the machine can also be used without the collector, allowing for bulk clearing afterwards.

Ideal for Medium to Large Lawns

Designed for areas up to 2000m², this machine is well-suited for larger gardens and demanding lawn care tasks. Its combination of power, durability, and versatility makes it a reliable choice for maintaining a healthy, well-presented lawn.

Final Thoughts

The Spectrum TG45SC is a powerful, all-in-one lawn care solution. Combining strong performance, adjustable settings, and durable construction, it delivers excellent results whether you’re scarifying or aerating. A practical and efficient choice for anyone looking to improve lawn health with minimal effort.

Tip: Keep moss and thatch separate from compost to prevent regrowth.

Key Features

  • Powerful 223cc petrol engine for reliable performance
  • 2-in-1 scarifying and aerating functionality
  • 6 adjustable working heights (-12mm to +10mm)
  • Durable steel deck construction
  • Foldable, soft-grip handles for comfort and storage
  • 45L debris collector for efficient clean-up
  • Double ball-bearing wheels for smooth movement
  • Suitable for lawns up to 2000m²

Overall Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4.9/5)

A highly versatile and robust scarifier/aerator that makes lawn rejuvenation straightforward—ideal for achieving a healthier, more resilient lawn with minimal effort.

title: Spectrum TG60FTTR Petrol Cultivator
description_html:
Spectrum TG60FTTR Petrol Front-Tine Tiller – Powerful & Efficient Soil Preparation

Gardeners, growers, and smallholders looking to break new ground, aerate soil, or prepare large plots for planting will find the Spectrum TG60FTTR Petrol Front-Tine Tiller an indispensable tool. Combining exceptional power, a wide tilling path, and user-friendly features, this tiller ensures efficient and effortless soil cultivation.

High-Performance 212cc OHV Engine

At the heart of the Spectrum TG60FTTR is a powerful 212cc, air-cooled, 4-stroke OHV petrol engine, delivering a muscular 7HP. This high-torque motor efficiently drives the six four-tine rotors, ensuring effortless penetration through compacted or uncultivated soil. A torque-optimising belt drive enhances power transfer, maximizing efficiency and durability.

60cm Working Width – ADJUSTABLE – remove the outer discs to reduce to 30cm for narrower rows

Designed for fast and effective soil preparation, the TG60FTTR boasts a class-leading 60cm tilling width, covering large areas quickly while reducing the number of passes required. Whether you’re cultivating allotments, vegetable gardens, flower beds, or paddocks, this wide cutting path ensures superior productivity.

Adjustable Depth Control – Dig Up to 330mm Deep

The rugged steel rotors effortlessly plough through the toughest soil, allowing you to dig as deep as 330mm. The depth-adjustable brake shoe enables precision control for a variety of tasks, from deep ploughing for root vegetables to surface-level weeding.

User-Friendly Features for Smooth Operation

  • Front-Mounted Transport Wheel – Easily move the tiller from shed to worksite without hassle.
  • Reverse Gear for Easy Manoeuvrability – Unlike standard tillers, the TG60FTTR features a reverse gear, allowing you to back out of tight spots or tricky corners and quickly free the machine if it digs too deep.
  • Durable & Robust Construction – Built for heavy-duty use, this tiller withstands challenging soil conditions while providing long-lasting reliability.

With its exceptional power, versatility, and user-friendly operation, the Spectrum TG60FTTR Petrol Front-Tine Tiller is the ideal choice for gardeners and smallholders who need fast, efficient, and hassle-free soil preparation.
